decision_rule.positive_label_rule: score >= 4 and wind_ratio_ge_1; OSM/dNBR unavailable controls are reported but not scored

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with numeric units implied by field names.
criteria.name: JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when the object is readable but misses one or two requested fields.

criteria.description: Computes the Sandy catalog wind ratio against 119 km/h and applies the >= 1 gate correctly.
criteria.name: Storm wind test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct wind speed or threshold but an incorrect ratio or gate.

criteria.description: Computes mean precipitation, maximum precipitation, concentration ratio, and the two precipitation gates.
criteria.name: Precipitation ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for partially correct precipitation arithmetic or rounding.

criteria.description: Uses the stated pixel rules after 256x192 RGB resizing and computes the L1 scene-change metric.
criteria.name: Image change metric
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct pixel classes but incomplete deltas or rounding.

criteria.description: Reports population in millions plus road/facility and dNBR scene counts, and treats unavailable OSM/dNBR controls as reported context rather than scored evidence of absence.
criteria.name: Exposure and control counts
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct population or counts but not both.

criteria.description: Sums the five substantive gates to a 5/5 score and returns the coastal flood and power-disruption consistency label.
criteria.name: Final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right label with a minor score or naming error.

source_values.event_name: Hurricane Sandy New York City coastal flood and power outage cascade
source_values.location_text: New York City and New Jersey coast
